items.item_text: Graduation from high school or a General Education Diploma
Bachelor’s degree in psychology or a related field

Minimum of 1 year of laboratory experience or two years of college courses in the natural, physical or social sciences and laboratory experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience; and knowledge and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.
Undergraduate level statistics course and experience with statistical analysis packages (e.g. Matlab, SPSS, R, etc.)
Experience with qualitative data coding software (e.g. Dedoose, NVivo)
Experience managing teams of research assistants
Experience with maintaining data security and IRB protocols
Experience conducting independent research in psychology
Experience with managing sensitive datasets
Experience working with community partners, participating in community service, or supporting community-engaged initiatives

Undergraduate Team Management: Recruit, interview, and manage a team of 8–10 undergraduate research assistants. Recruitment activities include distributing flyers and representing the lab at university and community events. Assist Dr. Arce with reviewing applications and interviewing candidates. Oversight responsibilities include onboarding/offboarding, training assistants on lab protocols, supervising data entry and coding, establishing efficient workflows, fostering professional development through lab workshops and journal clubs, and actively contributing to an inclusive lab culture. (40% time)

Data Management, Analysis & Protocols: Oversee data security, storage, quality control, analysis, and reproducibility. Manage participant confidentiality protocols, compensation tracking and disbursement, IRB paperwork, material transfer agreements, and data user agreements. Assist Dr. Arce in setting up, organizing, and maintaining secure lab data storage systems. Perform quality control checks, develop data cleaning and data coding protocols, generate progress reports, conduct literature reviews, and run descriptive statistics under Dr. Arce’s supervision. Ensure research rigor and reproducibility by drafting codebooks, lab manuals, and methodological protocols. Assist with active data collection and participant recruitment. (40% time)

Administrative Support: Handle day-to-day administrative duties, including scheduling meetings, updating website, and ordering equipment and supplies. Support email communications and actively contribute to the lab’s mission. (20% time)
